articles.headline: Kelsey Plum returns, debuts for Mercury after 'crazy 48 hours'
articles.description: Kelsey Plum said she felt caught in the Spider-Man "multiverse" as she was introduced as the newest member of the Mercury on Monday evening in Chicago, saying it feels as though she's operating in a few different dimensions at once.

images.name: Kelsey Plum  [600x400]
images.caption: "As far as the long-term stuff, it sounds cliché, but I am just where my feet are," said Kelsey Plum, who made her Mercury debut Monday night after a whirlwind 48 hours that saw her become just the fourth All-Star to be traded at the midseason deadline.
